caption: The drawing depicts a simplified bust of a human figure, likely female, shown from the shoulders up and facing to the right. The figure is outlined in thin black lines on a beige or light tan background. The head is oval-shaped and topped with a tight-fitting headdress or cap, which is delineated with a single seam line at the back. A large, irregularly shaped black area covers the top left portion of the head and extends down near the left eye, possibly representing hair or a decorative element. The face is depicted with minimal detail, including a single arched eyebrow, a small nose, two almond-shaped eyes, and a lightly curved mouth with upper and lower lips indicated by short lines. The neck is elongated, and the shoulders are narrow. The figure wears a garment with a deep V-shaped neckline edged in a thick black line, and within the upper edge of the garment, there are a series of semi-circular arc shapes, also outlined in black, that form a decorative pattern. The rest of the background is left empty. The composition is centered on the page, with the figure occupying only a small portion of the space. The color scheme is limited to black lines and shading on a plain beige or off-white background.
title: Hat Mannequin and Bonnet
